description:
Read coverage, unknown scored fields, and evidence guidance before drafting.

Takes the same product identifier as ``get_product`` — exactly one of
``product`` (canonical), ``id``, or the legacy ``product_id`` — so an agent
that learned a spelling from one tool reuses it here without a retry.

Returns the catalog API response unchanged, including attested absences.
Guidance and score projections do not corroborate proposed claims.

id.description: Alias for product, matching the REST {id-or-slug} route. Accepts a UUID or slug.

product_id.description: Legacy UUID-only argument. Use product instead.

name: get_product_coverage
title: Get Product Coverage
